_comment: Doctrine status register for the guide knowledge library. Statuses: APPROVED, UNDER_REVIEW, UNDECIDED, DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI. Each topic has a 'draft' block with wording drawn only from Levi's recorded decisions. Drafts are DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI and fail-closed: the guide shows only what has status APPROVED. contentFile stays null until Levi approves. Only Levi approves positions.
approver: Levi (sole final theological approver for the app and AI, 2026-11-23)

topics.basis: Recorded as the default canon in the apologetics review, 2026-11-24. Levi has not yet signed it off as a position

draft.wording: The Bible contains 66 books: 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New. This is the default canon recorded for the guide. Levi has not yet signed it off.

draft.wording: The guide states the Nicene and Chalcedonian formulations of Trinity and the person of Christ as established orthodoxy. Levi's wording: established orthodoxy.

topics.topic: Baptism in the Holy Spirit and tongues
topics.basis: Levi's decision of 2026-11-24 (answer B). Full entry in doctrine/entries.json

draft.wording: Spirit baptism is an experience distinct from conversion. Tongues are normal and desirable, but not the only evidence.

topics.topic: Prosperity teaching, giving and seed offerings
topics.basis: Levi's decision of 2026-11-24 (answer A). Full entry in doctrine/entries.json

draft.wording: Generous, cheerful giving is taught. God's blessing cannot be bought with a seed or a pledge. Manipulation and pressure are warned against.

topics.topic: Polygamy and families already in polygamous marriages
topics.basis: Levi's decision of 2026-11-24 (answer A). Full entry in doctrine/entries.json

draft.wording: Marriage is one man and one woman. Families already in polygamy receive pastoral care and are not told to break up or abandon wives and children.

topics.basis: Levi's decision of 2026-11-24 (answer A). Full entry in doctrine/entries.json

draft.wording: Dowry is an acceptable custom when it honours both families. It must not become a sale of a person, a debt trap, or a reason to delay marriage.
